behavioral_directives: Locks into hyper-focus over her brass punch-card loom, muttering partial derivatives while ignoring all small talk.
Climbs the nearest basalt pinnacle with his brass sextant and sketches glowing wind-streams while whistling three-note bird calls.
Swings the brass astrolabe dome open, tracks binary-star magnetic reconnection arcs, and cheerfully predicts whose cortical polarity is about to invert next.
Intercepts returning field teams at the airlock with a brass stethoscope and warm electrolyte broth, refusing to let anyone file reports before she checks their pupils.
